# Project context

## Output preferences

- Summary language: English. Keep the transcript in the spoken language.
- Preserve names and technical terms in their confirmed spelling.

## Confirmed people and aliases

| Name | Confirmed aliases | Role / relationship |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full name | Known spelling variants | Background only; not proof of speaker identity |

## Confirmed speaker mappings

Include a mapping only when verified. Identify the recording and the passage or timestamp where the person is known to speak. Anonymous speaker labels apply only within their excerpt unless independently confirmed.

## Project background

Describe the project, relevant collaborators, and workflow. Separate background responsibilities from assignments made in a particular meeting.

## Terminology

| Preferred term | Meaning / supported variants |
| --- | --- |
| Term | Definition |

## Unresolved names and facts

List uncertain spellings, competing interpretations, and what would establish the answer. Keep these separate from confirmed aliases.

## Evidence boundaries

Distinguish user-confirmed facts, source documents, and information inferred from past meeting summaries. A prior summary does not independently verify its own claims. Include essential facts directly: MeetingLog passes this file and the global context to the provider, but does not follow Markdown links.
